messages:
auditor_mark: Morning. For our SOC2 fieldwork we need: 1) RBAC change history (service-accounts + console edits) for last 6 months, 2) KMS rotation provenance and proof-of-rotation, 3) one IR playback where an account was deprovisioned. Prefer raw logs + hash-signed bundle. Which artifacts map to CC6 and who owns them?

sophia_sec: hey @auditor_mark  we can assemble that. Quick Q: do you want per-event request IDs so you can correlate with access logs and SIEM traces?

auditor_mark: yes please include request_id, session_token/session_id, and any trace ids (x-amzn-trace-id or our internal trace_id). Also need explanation of how console UI edits surface in our audit index.

ben_infra: short answer: API-level (service-account) edits show up in CloudTrail (IAM & STS events), UI changes are proxied through auth-proxy and emitted as audit.event: ui.role_change in our internal audit-index. We include a correlation_id on both sides when proxied.

ben_infra: example internal audit record:
```
{
  "time":"2025-04-02T09:21:10Z",
  "event":"ui.role_change",
  "actor":"alice@example.com",
  "resource":"team/sre",
  "before":"[role:viewer]",
  "after":"[role:admin]",
  "correlation_id":"corr-0a1b2c3d",
  "request_id":"req-7f8e9d"
}
```

sophia_sec: for KMS we emit kms.rotation.proof objects to audit-index including rotation_time, rotation_id, key_arn, signing_proof (sha256) and hsm_audit_ref when applicable. CloudTrail will also contain CreateKeyRotation and ScheduleKeyDeletion entries where relevant.

olivia_sre: kicked off an export job: job id job-20250612-02. Bundle will include: rbac_raw.ndjson, internal_audit.ndjson, kms_rotations.ndjson, ir_playback.md, manifest.sha256, manifest.sig. Uploading to s3://redwood-audit-exports/job-20250612-02 now. ETA ~20m.

devops-bot: job-20250612-02 started by olivia_sre. Objects: s3://redwood-audit-exports/job-20250612-02/{rbac_raw.ndjson,kms_rotations.ndjson,ir_playback.md,manifest.sha256,manifest.sig}. Generating presigned links (7 days).

devops-bot: Presigned links:
- https://s3-presigned.example/job-20250612-02/rbac_raw.ndjson
- https://s3-presigned.example/job-20250612-02/internal_audit.ndjson
- https://s3-presigned.example/job-20250612-02/kms_rotations.ndjson
- https://s3-presigned.example/job-20250612-02/ir_playback.md
- https://s3-presigned.example/job-20250612-02/manifest.sha256
- https://s3-presigned.example/job-20250612-02/manifest.sig

auditor_mark: great. A few follow-ups: 1) Does kms_rotations include HSM attestation references or just KMS metadata? 2) For the IR playback, can you include the vuln ticket id and timeline of containment actions?

sophia_sec: 1) we include hsm_audit_ref when the key is backed by HSM and the module returns an attestation token. The rotation record stores hsm_attestation_jwt reference (not the raw token) and a signed proof blob (sha256). 2) IR playback will contain a redacted timeline, runbook steps executed, ticket link (redacted identifiers ok). Example timeline snippet:
- 2025-03-08T11:03: triage (ticket T-4421)
- 2025-03-08T11:12: revoke creds (action by bob)
- 2025-03-08T11:20: rotate keys (km rotation id rot-20250308-a)
- 2025-03-08T11:30: verification and closure

ben_infra: note on retention: our internal audit-index keeps hot data 180 days. Older internal audit events move to Glacier-like archive. CloudTrail kept for 365 days in primary account. If you later request >6 months for internal-audit we need ~48h to restore.

auditor_mark: ok. Also need mapping doc that ties files to SOC2 CC6/CC8 and ISO A.9/A.10. Please add simple mapping text file in the bundle.

olivia_sre: adding control_mapping.txt to bundle. Sample mapping lines:
CC6 (changes) -> rbac_raw.ndjson, internal_audit.ndjson
CC8 (crypto) -> kms_rotations.ndjson, HSM attestation refs
IR-3 -> ir_playback.md, runbook snapshots
ISO A.9.2 -> rbac_raw.ndjson
ISO A.10.1 -> kms_rotations.ndjson

sophia_sec: tamper-evidence: manifest.sha256 lists sha256 for each file (hex). manifest.sig is an Ed25519 signature over manifest.sha256 using our evidence-upload key. Verifier steps: sha256sum each file -> compare to manifest.sha256 -> verify signature with ed25519-verifier. Example: `ed25519_verify -pub pubkey.pem -sig manifest.sig -data manifest.sha256`.

auditor_mark: Perfect. Please ensure each RBAC event has correlation_id + request_id. Also, include a short note on how we triage related vulnerabilities (link to vuln handling doc).

ben_infra: included a vincibility note in control_mapping.txt with link: https://redwood.internal/vuln-triage-runbook (requires access). For the RBAC CSV export we add headers: event_time,actor,actor_type,correlation_id,request_id,action,resource,before,after,trace_hash

auditor_mark: thanks team. If I need extended access to raw archives I'll request separately. We'll validate the bundle and come back with any chain-of-custody questions. :white_check_mark:

sophia_sec: thanks, ping us if signature verification or file formats need clarifying. We can re-run export as signed ZIP if you need longer retention.

olivia_sre: FYI export auto-deletes presigned links after 7 days; we can ship a signed S3 copy with 90-day TTL on request.

auditor_mark: will request 90-day copy if verification takes longer. Appreciate the fast turnaround!
